newsitem.title: QATAR: Bulls push Qatar shares up after official opening.
newsitem.headline: Bulls push Qatar shares up after official opening.

text.p: Bullish investors pushed the price of key shares on Qatar's new official stock exchange higher in active trade in the week to Thursday, brokers said.

The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 17-share index rose 1.5 percent to 131.17 points in the first few days of trade on the official Doha Securities Market. The exchange has not set up its own official index yet.
The bourse said turnover on Thursday alone was more than 2.82 million riyals ($774,000) -- almost twice the volume on a normal day before the official floor opened on Monday.
A total of 9,879 shares worth 3.24 million riyals changed hands in the week.

The largest trade was in Qatar National Bank shares, which account for a third of the total market capitalisation of almost $2 billion. Around 5,000 QNB shares were sold at 555 riyals -- 10 riyals higher than the previous week.
Doha Bank Ltd rose 25 riyals to 325 and Qatar Navigation notched up 35 riyals to 725. The CBQ gained two riyals and Qatar Shipping one riyal, closing at 307 and 47 respectively.
Other gainers which added two riyals each were Qatar Insurance at 552, Al Khaleej Insurance at 267, Qatar Cement at 307 and Qatar Flour Mills also at 307.
Losers included Qatar General Insurance, which dived 270 riyals to 375, and Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company which lost five riyals to 60 as they went ex-dividend.
